pages.title: Private Libraries
pages.text: Network ownership and image-library ownership are separate.

pages.title: Private Libraries
pages.text: Sharing a screen permits viewing its displayed image according to its viewing policy; it does not grant browsing, deletion, or reuse of the owner's whole library.

pages.title: Nearby Interaction
pages.text: Editing requires being nearby and able to interact with the display.$(br2)Knowing an image UUID does not grant access to its bytes.

pages.title: Nearby Interaction
pages.text: Viewing through a screen requires the server to be tracking that permitted display for the player.
